headline: Dangote Refinery IPO Meets Target with Global Investor Demand
summary: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE received sufficient commitments from Nigerian and retail investors to meet its initial public offering target, drawing applications from 119 countries.
why: The Dangote Refinery is a massive mega-project intended to reshape fuel supply and foreign exchange dynamics in Nigeria and across West Africa.

impacts.name: Nigerian Energy and Refining
impacts.why: Successful local and international capital raising supports the operational scale of Africa's largest refinery.

why_moved: A successful IPO meeting its fundraising target provides substantial capital injection and validates investor appetite for large-scale African refining assets.
